notes.text: ד״ה א׳ פ״ד-כח gives I Chronicles chapter 4, verse 28: the final 28 must not be dropped. This is the supplied locator, without independent named-edition verification; earlier machine פ״דהבה differs.

ע. gives Sanhedrin 70a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. The city-name example and Chanan bar Moladah are separate attestations; no geographic/identity link is established. Rav is full.
